**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Madam](../persons.html#2166)
I am very sorry I cannot help you to [Ben Sylvester](../books.html#25). I have not even one of my own except in a bound up volume, and the copyright is not mine.

But if you enquired for it direct from [Innes ](../persons.html#744)they might find a last copy, or be stirred to a reprint.

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Endorsed in another hand ‘from Miss A.H.Walker, Wokingham’, with envelope addressed to \'Mrs Walker/ Gordon Boys Home/ Woking.\' postmarked 30 March 1897.
